Privacy

Last updated 18 November 2026.

What this website collects

This website has no forms and no accounts. A small script counts taps on the WhatsApp, call, email, Facebook and map buttons so we can see which buttons help visitors. It records the button, the page, the device type, the time zone set on your device and a random visit code. It does not record your name or phone number.

When you contact us

When you WhatsApp, call or email us, we see what you send, such as your number and your message, and use it only to reply about your car.

Other services

Links to WhatsApp, Facebook and Google Maps open those services, which have their own privacy policies.
